messages:
hannah: Big shoutout to @tia for setting up the surprise 'Thanks Wall' in the lobby this morning  everyone left tiny notes and it honestly made my whole week. :sparkling_heart::sunny:
tia: Glad people liked it! Wanted a way to let folks say quick thanks beyond Slack. Left sticky notes, a marker station, and a small playlist QR taped to the board.
kevin: That playlist is fire. Spotted two engineering interns adding their own messages too  felt wholesome. Who brought the mini cupcakes? :cupcake::eyes:
r: ryan: That was me  bakery run at 09:30. Glad they landed well. If anyone has allergies listed, DM me and I'll mark the leftover box.
ops-bot: DELIVERY: 1 x assorted mini cupcakes (order #CKP-4412) delivered to Lobby at 09:36. Leftover box stored in Kitchen marked 'Thanks Wall Leftovers'.
maya: Tia, consider yourself nominated for this week's "Kindness Courier" shoutout on the roundup. Also would you mind sharing the playlist link so we can add it to the company wellness notes?
tia: Yay thanks! Playlist: https://music.internal/thanks-wall-playlist. Also I left a tiny how-to note on the board for anyone who wants to run future walls (materials, timing, quick template).
hannah: Love the idea of a recurring thing. Maybe once a month? Quick poll: React with :heart: for monthly, :star: for one-off surprise events.
kevin: :heart: (monthly please)
ryan: :star: (surprise keeps it special)
maya: :heart: (monthly, & I can help rotate themes)
tia: Either works. I'll start a doc in People Ops titled "Thanks Wall playbook" and drop a short checklist. Tagging facilities for more sticky notes in the next supply run.
ops-bot: FYI: Facilities supply request 'STICKY-REQ-2026' created. Estimated restock: 4 business days.
hannah: Thanks again, Tia and everyone who scribbled a kind line. Tiny public gestures like this change team vibes more than you'd think. Also leaving a tiny candy jar next to the board as a thank-you for contributors :candy:
